text:
Nina: quick pass on the compare UI — attached figma: https://figma.redwood/compare-ux-v7. main frictions: badge clutter, pin ambiguity, and filter wording that trips new folks.

Omar: agreed. the perf badges feel heavy. can we move to thin outline chips with an icon? keeps scan tight.

Priya: the filter named 'Model signature' is confusing. users mix signature with model size. propose splitting to 'Architecture' and 'Variant signature' or just 'Family'.

Evan: a11y: current chips use white text on colored backgrounds at 11px — contrast fails for amber/green. run through axe and WCAG.

Marta: pin behavior question — are pins per-user or shared by default? current mock looks workspace-shared which is surprising for many.

Nina: prefer per-user default with an obvious menu option to "Share pin with workspace" and a confirmation. keeps discoverability low for novices.

DesignBot: accessibility scan: chip-amber #FFB84D on white -> 2.6:1. recommendations: dark text (#3F2A00), 1px stroke, or outlined chip with dark text.

Omar: copy tweak for pin label: change "Pinned - v2" to "Pinned for you — v2" and for shared pins "Pinned to workspace — v2". clearer in co-editing.

Priya: density modes idea: per-user toggle compact/comfy. compact shows only icons + tiny chips, comfy shows full labels and legend. persist preference.

Evan: hover/focus parity: hover expands chip after 120ms; keyboard focus must trigger same expand immediately and respect prefers-reduced-motion. add aria-live for status updates.

Nina: proposal: 1) outlined chips with dark text, 2) per-user density toggle persisted, 3) pin default per-user with optional share, 4) legend panel with perf thresholds and links. thumbs?

Marta: thumbs from me. i'll prototype the pin menu with share toggle and confirmation modal.

Omar: i'll mock outlined chips + icon set and motion-reduced variant.

Evan: i'll validate color tokens and keyboard flow, post a short a11y checklist.

Nina: thanks — will follow up after mocks land. DesignBot: please remind to upload tokens to /shared/design-tokens.

DesignBot: reminder sent.
